reviews.t: Good Product -- prefer to Bag Balm
reviews.x: I was looking for a product with a higher oxyquinolone content.  This reportedly has 0.14% oxyquinolone , compared with Bag Balm's 0.3% oxyquinolone sulfate.  Product works pretty well.  I prefer Dr Naylor's udder balm to Bag Balm -- I believe it has a higher lanolin content, smells medicinal, and is less greasy.

I bought this for my husband for a rash on his leg it took the rash away within 2 days. This is an excellent product it works way better than Bag Balm.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the balm for healing dry, cracked, and chapped skin, including hands and heels.
Many customers report it effectively clears up rashes and other stubborn skin problems when other treatments failed.
Several reviewers compare it favorably to Bag Balm, preferring its texture or ingredients.
A recurring complaint is that the product leaks oil from the lid or arrives damaged and leaking during shipping.
Some customers report poor or slow shipping service despite liking the product itself.
